exposure: COVID-19 pandemic period (pre-COVID vs. post-COVID outbreak)
outcome: treatment for upper respiratory tract infection
cohort: The study included two groups of pregnant patients who attended the labor room: 280 patients pre-COVID pandemic and 193 patients post-COVID pandemic.
finding: The analysis confirmed a significantly higher usage of antibiotics during pregnancy, especially in the second and third trimesters, and an increase in treatments for urinary tract infection and bacterial vaginosis in the post-COVID-19 outbreak period.
cross-section timing: Retrospectively compared pre-COVID pandemic and post-COVID-19 pandemic periods, before the development of full COVID-19 vaccinations.
